diagnostic: ending titles observed only in visible ending screen, egg is nested perfect variant; no points for ordinary collection/chapters

endings.perfect: holes >=7, at least 4 of 5 viewpoints >=60, alert<=50
endings.both: otherwise score>=10; narrative full ending, no literal death
endings.killed: otherwise; game lost and explicit retry, terminal failure

latching: new Judge for each episode; title hooks check screen visibility, no hidden-text matches
source_caveats: need uses ANY evidence, not all
pickOpt unconditionally adds hole and gotEv even on fail
top toolbar opens messages/mail/log for zero AP; probe buttons spend AP but can be bypassed normally
compareLog rewards fixed entries without asking player to identify contradiction
ending restart showIntro retains state; refresh or failure btnRetry resets state
formal_review: do not certify a reasoning benchmark from scripted known-answer/source routes
